detail: Decisions: Pending drain uses per-drain unique swap files with claim-by-rename recovery — at-least-once semantics where duplicates are possible under concurrent drains but an appended post can never be lost; the original fixed-name swap had a microsecond cross-process unlink window the reviewer traced.
summary: 1.24 T3: pending queue drains every 60s with loss-proof rename-swap (unique names + claim-by-rename after review); migrate salvages index-orphaned decisions via directory scan.
